custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new part number that no Part Library entry has yet, so saving the part must make a new entry.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description shows what you typed.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the new number.

Step 4:

  • Category shows the category you picked.

Step 5:

  • Cost shows 10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.
  • No message about the Part Library appears, because a new entry was made and no existing one was linked.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Exactly one entry is listed for the new part number, with the description you typed.

Step 9:

  • Its detail page shows "Total parts" 1, with one Workplace row for the test location: the new inventory part is behind it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”
  • S7-R7: “If no entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry with the typed number and description, and links the part to it.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
  • S11-N1: “No route, on screen or behind it, produces a Part Library entry with no inventory part, part request, delivery receipt, core charge, return or import row behind it. The one exception is the public API (S11-E3).”
  • Key Decisions: “The Part Library has no standalone create. Every Part Library entry is created from a part number in use. In the reference dataset 19,664 of 29,376 entries had no inventory part behind them and 17,359 were referenced by nothing at all.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
